PLAN "12-week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and improved glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full body strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full body strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full body progress":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Conditioned lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full body deload":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Low impact cardio + core":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          marching 3x2..3 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper deload":
        warmup:

          incline_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Strength & Metabolic" (4 weeks):

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower power + metabolic":

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper accessory":

          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds

        cooldown:

    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Mixed strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Metabolic circuits":
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          jump_rope 3x60..90 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Low impact cardio":
        warmup:
          cycling 15m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 45m "Accessory deload":
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Peak & Cut" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength + metabolic":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Circuit conditioning":
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:

          walking_lunge 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper strength":
        warmup:

          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Hypertrophy focus":
        warmup:

    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intensity taper":
        warmup:

          superman 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds

      DAY Friday training 45m "Assessment session":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Energy balance: aim for a modest deficit of ~300-500 kcal/day from estimated maintenance to support fat loss while minimising hypoglycaemia risk."
    - "Protein: target 1.2-1.6 g/kg bodyweight per day (preserve lean mass). Prefer lean sources at meals and evenly distribute across meals."
    - "Carbohydrate distribution: prioritise moderate carbohydrate intake with even distribution across meals (e.g. 3-4 meals + 1 snack). Emphasise low glycaemic index carbohydrates (oats, legumes, whole grains, non-starchy vegetables)."
    - "Pre/post workouts: include 20-30 g protein with 20-40 g carbohydrate pre- or post-workout as tolerated to support performance and glucose stability; prefer whole-food carbohydrate sources."
    - "Fibre and fats: include high-fibre vegetables and healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts) to slow glucose absorption and support satiety."
    - "Meal timing: avoid long fasting >12 hours for clients on metformin to reduce risk of glycaemic variability; maintain regular meal pattern."
    - "Medication considerations: metformin reduces hepatic glucose output and generally has low hypoglycaemia risk, but monitor symptoms if changing activity or calorie intake. Advise client to consult prescribing clinician before medication changes."
    - "Glucose monitoring: recommend checking capillary blood glucose if symptomatic, and consider pre/post exercise checks initially (e.g. before exercise and 30-60 minutes after) to learn individual response."
    - "Alcohol: limit intake and avoid on an empty stomach; alcohol can increase hypoglycaemia risk when combined with reduced intake."
    - "Hydration: maintain adequate hydration; dehydration can worsen glycaemic control."
    - "Progression: adjust calorie deficit if HbA1c or symptoms worsen; prioritise slow consistent weight loss (~0.25-0.5 kg/week)."

  SAMPLE_DAY:
    - "Breakfast: 30-40 g oats with 200 ml milk or unsweetened milk alternative, 1 scoop protein or 20-30 g plain Greek yoghurt, berries, 10 g nuts."
    - "Mid-morning snack: 1 small apple with 20 g nut butter or 150 g cottage cheese."
    - "Lunch: mixed salad bowl with 100-150 g lean protein (chicken/fish/tofu), 1/2 cup cooked quinoa or brown rice, lots of leafy vegetables, olive oil dressing."
    - "Pre-workout (if training later): small wholegrain toast or banana + 20 g protein 30-60 minutes pre-exercise."
    - "Post-workout dinner: 120-150 g lean protein, large non-starchy vegetables, 1 small baked sweet potato or 1/2 cup legumes."
    - "Evening snack (if needed): 150 g plain Greek yoghurt or 2 boiled eggs and raw vegetables."

  MONITORING:
    - "Track weight weekly and waist circumference monthly."
    - "Re-check HbA1c after 12 weeks with prescribing clinician."
    - "Adjust nutrition if hypoglycaemia symptoms occur: increase carbohydrate at meals/snacks or reduce deficit and consult clinician."

SAFETY
  NOTES:
    - "Avoid maximal exertion without prior conditioning; progress RPE and loads gradually."
    - "If peripheral neuropathy or retinopathy present, avoid high-impact loading or Valsalva — substitute as needed (use lower impact cardio and reduce heavy spinal loading)."
    - "Stop exercise and check glucose if symptomatic (dizziness, palpitations, sweating)."
    - "Ensure footwear and foot care for diabetes; inspect feet regularly."
    - "Encourage communication with client's primary care/endocrinologist for medication adjustment if exercise/weight change is substantial."
